147-5686-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5686-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

512-1336-1719.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-1719.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-1719.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2292-7388--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

573-1479-7889.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

997-1742-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
997-1742-5003-7848.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-1742-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

431-4365-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4365-6753-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5705-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

670-1619-6136-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6136-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Avenging Hunter to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-7280-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Donatello.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2933-4013-5434-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-4184-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-4184-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

891-1258-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

620-2146-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-2146-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

1978-4002-5089.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-5089.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

856-1379-6748-6757-6797.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3652-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

5572-6249-6798--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5572-6249-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2058-2073-6798.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

509-1267-2392-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-2392-4883.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2392-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2392-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

3129-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
3129-4770-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1818-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

648-1080-1880.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{G/U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1080-1880.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand with kicker or multikicker.
648-1080-1880.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cast Bioshift by paying {G/U}, moving all +1/+1 counters from the Fractal onto Hallar.
The Fractal dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

1215-4044-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hope of Ghirapur, adding {C}{C}.
When Hope of Ghirapur dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Hope of Ghirapur on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hope of Ghirapur from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

228-540-4474-4763.description:
Activate Paradise Mantle by paying {0}, attaching it to Fervent Champion.
Activate Fervent Champion by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Skullclamp's ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Fervent Champion.
Fervent Champion dies due to having 0 toughness.
Koll and Skullclamp trigger.
Resolve Skullclamp's trigger, drawing two cards.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Fervent Champion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Fervent Champion by paying {R}.
Repeat.

2094-3316-3520-4772-4873.description:
Activate Cascading Cataracts's second ability by paying {5} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Cast Clearwater Goblet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Cast Dismantle by paying {2}{R}, targeting Clearwater Goblin and placing 20 charge counters on Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, winning you the game.

864-2103-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Eternal Witness.
864-2103-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
